title: The S&P 500 Is At All-Time Highs... I'm Shorting It!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Record highs driven by AI names mask weakness: worst 10-year bond returns, trade deficit at a 17-month high, foreclosures up 42% y/y.
Markets always pull back; avoid margin at elevated levels.

calls.reason: Shorted the overbought move at record highs intraday (closed same day); warns markets always pull back and he is ready to strike on pullbacks.
calls.quote: I'm telling you like markets always pull on back. I'm not here to predict anything, but they always do.

calls.reason: Oversold after the Toshiba-news selloff from lows of 396; possible dip-buy for those bullish on markets.
calls.quote: Now, it's oversold, possibly entertaining maybe a, you know, dip by opportunity

calls.condition: Short if it retests tomorrow and price action is in his favor.
calls.reason: Overbought reversal setup after a 7.5% rip; on his watch list to short.
calls.quote: I still think that the setup is there. It's an overbought reversal.

calls.reason: Stopped shorting MSTR because the trend has been incredibly bullish.
calls.quote: It's been incredibly bullish lately, and I have to respect the trend.

notes: Date: host says S&P hit new highs 'today' and the Fed minutes are 'tomorrow' => Tue 2026-10-06 after close (listing approx 2026-10-07). He garbles minutes timing ('2 p.m. Eastern ... about 2 hours before the markets open'). Calls are intraday-trader views, low conviction. WDC 'lows of 396' in WDC dollars. Includes a home-equity/foreclosure solicitation.
